title: create_spell_variation specification
description: Composite RE gameplay-source to presentation-variation contract. Reads one FREAbilityDef source row, clones it to a scratch target row, overrides selected VFX soft paths, and requires protected gameplay fields to compare equal after re-read.

ability_table.description: Read-only FREAbilityDef DataTable that owns the source gameplay behavior.

target_row.description: New row identity in the scratch target DataTable.

presentation_asset.description: Resolved variation asset assigned only to the selected VFX phase.
